categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, manufacturing and sales of sterile single-use infusion medical devices, including syringes, infusion/transfusion sets, and medical puncture needles. Additionally, the company provides integrated supply of other diagnostic and clinical care products. The company operates primarily through an ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) plus integrated supply model to meet international medical device brand manufacturers' one-stop procurement needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has established a complete research and development system with mature production processes and comprehensive quality control systems. Key technologies include automated production equipment for injection molding, silicone coating, needle assembly and testing, extrusion, and sterilization. The company has achieved high automation in production, particularly in packaging of infusion sets. The company holds 101 patents (5 invention patents, 79 utility model patents, 17 design patents) and 70 software copyrights.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves international medical device brand manufacturers as ODM customers, with business concentrated in overseas markets (96.88% of revenue). Key customer types include medical device companies in Europe, Asia, and the Americas. The company has established long-term stable cooperation with multiple international medical device brand manufacturers. Domestically, the company sells through distributors to hospitals and medical institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's sales network covers Asia, Europe, and the Americas, with operations in over 80 countries and regions globally. Overseas revenue represents 96.88% of total revenue. The company is headquartered in Anhui Province, China, with manufacturing facilities in Taihu County, Anqing City. The company also operates through a wholly-owned subsidiary for import-export business.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the medical device supply chain. As an ODM manufacturer, the company handles design, development, and production of medical devices for brand manufacturers who handle downstream sales and distribution. The company also engages in integrated supply of related medical products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation-driven development with emphasis on sterile single-use infusion medical devices. R&D priorities include developing safety-enhanced products (safety blood collection needles, safety injection needles), advanced infusion devices, and new product categories such as auto-retractable needles, wearable injection devices, and needle-free injection systems. The company invested 12.97 million yuan in R&D in 2024, representing 2.72% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of medical devices. The ODM model involves designing and manufacturing products according to customer specifications, with customers responsible for sales under their own brands. The company also generates revenue through integrated supply of complementary medical products. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon shipment for overseas sales and upon delivery for domestic sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer of sterile single-use infusion medical devices with significant automation capabilities. The company competes with other medical device manufacturers on product quality, production efficiency, delivery reliability, and innovation. The company has established competitive advantages through specialized focus on infusion devices, advanced automation, and established international customer relationships. The company is among the few domestic enterprises with automated infusion set packaging technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized medical device manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 477.43 million yuan, down 10.54% from 533.68 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 39.97 million yuan in 2024, down 33.68% from 60.27 million yuan in 2023. Total assets were 872.67 million yuan at year-end 2024. The company has experienced revenue decline in 2024 due to global trade policy changes, geopolitical tensions, and increased market competition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes pursuit of excellent quality and protection of human health. Key differentiators include: specialized focus on infusion devices with deep technical expertise; high-level automation reducing production costs and improving quality consistency; established international customer relationships and brand recognition; comprehensive quality management systems certified by multiple international standards (FDA, CE, ISO13485); and integrated supply capabilities providing one-stop solutions for customers. The company's safety-enhanced products and advanced manufacturing processes provide competitive advantages in quality and reliability.
